SELECT "b"."Id", "b"."Album", "b"."AlbumArtists", "b"."Artists", "b"."Audio", "b"."ChannelId", "b"."CleanName", "b"."CommunityRating", "b"."CriticRating", "b"."CustomRating", "b"."Data", "b"."DateCreated", "b"."DateLastMediaAdded", "b"."DateLastRefreshed", "b"."DateLastSaved", "b"."DateModified", "b"."EndDate", "b"."EpisodeTitle", "b"."ExternalId", "b"."ExternalSeriesId", "b"."ExternalServiceId", "b"."ExtraType", "b"."ForcedSortName", "b"."Genres", "b"."Height", "b"."IndexNumber", "b"."InheritedParentalRatingSubValue", "b"."InheritedParentalRatingValue", "b"."IsFolder", "b"."IsInMixedFolder", "b"."IsLocked", "b"."IsMovie", "b"."IsRepeat", "b"."IsSeries", "b"."IsVirtualItem", "b"."LUFS", "b"."MediaType", "b"."Name", "b"."NormalizationGain", "b"."OfficialRating", "b"."OriginalLanguage", "b"."OriginalTitle", "b"."Overview", "b"."OwnerId", "b"."ParentId", "b"."ParentIndexNumber", "b"."Path", "b"."PreferredMetadataCountryCode", "b"."PreferredMetadataLanguage", "b"."PremiereDate", "b"."PresentationUniqueKey", "b"."PrimaryVersionId", "b"."ProductionLocations", "b"."ProductionYear", "b"."RunTimeTicks", "b"."SeasonId", "b"."SeasonName", "b"."SeriesId", "b"."SeriesName", "b"."SeriesPresentationUniqueKey", "b"."ShowId", "b"."Size", "b"."SortName", "b"."StartDate", "b"."Studios", "b"."Tagline", "b"."Tags", "b"."TopParentId", "b"."TotalBitrate", "b"."Type", "b"."UnratedType", "b"."Width"
FROM "BaseItems" AS "b"
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT "b0"."SeriesPresentationUniqueKey" AS "SeriesKey", MAX("u"."LastPlayedDate") AS "MaxDate"
    FROM "UserData" AS "u"
    INNER JOIN "BaseItems" AS "b0" ON "u"."ItemId" = "b0"."Id"
    WHERE "u"."Played" AND "b0"."SeriesPresentationUniqueKey" IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY "b0"."SeriesPresentationUniqueKey"
) AS "s" ON "b"."PresentationUniqueKey" = "s"."SeriesKey"
ORDER BY "s"."MaxDate" DESC, "b"."SortName"

raw.sourceBoundary: Actual frozen Episode/Season Series, FindSeriesId, FindSeriesSortName, Episode.AiredSeasonNumber, GetUserDataKeys and BaseItem.GetParents getters. Lookup stub only resolves explicit IDs; default ServerConfiguration is controlled for real SortName getter. savedAncestorIds are deliberately contradictory evidence inputs; getters never receive or query them. Alias Episode is actually deserialized with System.Text.Json then explicit ignored fields are assigned; its serialized Series and SeriesId are ignored. Actual frozen BaseItemRepository.ApplyOrder/ApplySeriesDatePlayedOrder and OrderMapper run against actual JellyfinDbContext/SQLite provider to produce EF SQL with ToQueryString; no database connection/query/HTTP request is executed. Entity lookup, default configuration and unused locking interfaces are controlled. No production files or existing matrices are edited by this oracle.
